what: The zhen build study 2 measures. Frozen before phase 1.
sha256_meaning: Identifies this artifact, not this source. Two builds of the same commit at the same path differ; see REPRODUCIBILITY.md, 'What the checksum is for'. The binary reports its own commit (zhen --version, run.tool in every artifact), and harness/provenance.py hashes the binary it runs, so a replacement is visible in the data.
frozen_packages: zhen-swift/zhen-core (the whole package: ZhenCore, ZhenDarwin, zhen)
deferred_defects: zhen-core Docs/process/0.8.0-questions.md: Q5, Q7, Q13, Q20 and Q22 are open; none blocks the freeze. Gate evidence is in Docs/process/0.8.0-progress.md (gate T, and G9 against this binary on 2026-10-17).

supersedes.why: Study 1's binary (netsanity 0.4.0). Study 2 measures zhen 0.8.0, whose default waits per address; study 1's mechanism stays reachable in this binary as --reach learned --no-neighbor-watch.
